free_design.Place: A sheltered seaside reading terrace with a broad stone sill and sea fog drifting beyond the open arches.
free_design.Activity: She warms her hands on a simple clay cup while watch­ing the tide, having rolled back her lounging sleeves to keep them dry.
free_design.Pose: Seated in a low window seat, facing three-quarter toward the camera with a slight head turn toward the water. Her right hand holds the cup handle with the forearm in view; her left hand supports the base of the cup from below.
free_design.Framing: Portrait 2:3, waist to slightly above the head at window-seat eye height, with the hands and mug at the lower center.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque pale jade lingerie-inspired longline lounge camisole with scalloped lace edging and matching high-waisted lounge shorts. The sleeves of a lightweight open bed jacket are rolled back to reveal her forearms; the opaque camisole remains secure.
